blocks.text: Savol: Do you work? Does she work?

2- va 4-darslarda savol yasash uchun **am / is / are** ni egadan oldinga chiqargandik: **Are** you ready? **Is** she working? Present Simple'da esa gapda **be** yo'q (You work. She lives here.), shuning uchun 6-darsdagi yordamchi fe'l — **do / does** — gap boshiga chiqadi: **Do** you work? **Does** she live here? O'zbekchada esa fe'lga `-mi` qo'shamiz: «Ishlaysiz**mi**?», «U shu yerda yashaydi**mi**?». Inglizchada **do / does** savol «belgisi» vazifasini bajaradi, o'zi tarjima qilinmaydi.

Inkordagi kabi, **-s** fe'ldan **does** ga ko'chadi: She work**s** → **Does** she work? («Does she works?» emas). Tartib doim bir xil: **Do / Does** + ega + fe'l (yalang'och) + qolgan qism. **Do** — I, you, we, they va ko'plik bilan; **Does** — he, she, it va bitta kishi / narsa bilan.
Qisqa javoblar: Yes, I do. / No, she doesn't.

Qisqa javobda savoldagi yordamchi fe'l qaytariladi, asosiy fe'l takrorlanmaydi: **Do** you like tea? — Yes, I **do**. / No, I **don't**. **Does** he smoke? — No, he **doesn't**. O'zbekchada esa javobda asosiy fe'l takrorlanadi («Yoqadimi? — Ha, yoqadi»), shuning uchun «Yes, I like» deyish oson — lekin bu xato. Javobdagi fe'l savolning **birinchi so'zi** bilan bir xil bo'ladi: Do → do, Does → does, Are → am / are.

items.text: Do you play tennis? — No, **I don't**.
Does your sister speak English? — Yes, **she does**.
Do they have a garden? — Yes, **they do**.

blocks.text: So'roq so'zlari bilan: Where do you live?

So'roq so'zi doim gap boshida: so'roq so'zi + **do / does** + ega + fe'l. **Where** do you live? **What** does she want? O'zbekchada so'roq so'zi fe'l oldida, gap ichida turadi («Siz **qayerda** yashaysiz?»), inglizchada esa — eng oldinda, undan keyin darhol **do / does**. **What do you do?** — tayyor ibora: «Kasbingiz nima?» (ikkinchi **do** — «qilmoq» fe'li).

rows: **What does** he want? — U nima xohlaydi?
**What time does** the film start? — Film soat nechada boshlanadi?
**How do** you get to work? — Ishga qanday borasiz?
**How often do** you see her? — Uni qanchalik tez-tez ko'rasiz?
**How much does** it cost? — Bu qancha turadi?
**What kind of** films **do** you like? — Qanaqa filmlarni yoqtirasiz?

blocks.text: Am / is / are yoki do / does?

Savoldan oldin o'zingizdan so'rang: gapda **be** bormi? Sifat, joy, kasb, yosh yoki **-ing** bo'lsa — **am / is / are** oldinga chiqadi. Boshqa har qanday fe'l (like, live, work, have) bo'lsa — **do / does** qo'shiladi. Ikkalasi birga kelmaydi: «Are you like tea?», «Do you are hungry?» — xato.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «You like tea?» → **Do you like tea?**; «Does she works here?» → **Does she work here?**; «Where you live?» / «Where you are live?» → **Where do you live?**; «Where does she lives?» → **Where does she live?**; «Do she know?» → **Does she know?**; «Are you like football?» → **Do you like football?**; «Do you like it? — Yes, I like.» → **Yes, I do.**
Eslab qolish: **Does** savolni boshlasa, **-s** «band» — fe'l yalang'och qoladi. Qisqa javob esa savolning «aks-sadosi»: **Do** you ...? — I **do**. **Does** she ...? — she **does**.

Bog'lanish: inkor (don't / doesn't) — 6-dars; **What are you doing?** (hozir) va **What do you do?** (kasb) farqi — 8-dars; o'tgan zamonda savol (**Did** you go?) — 12-dars; savollar umumlashtirilgan holda — 44–47-darslar.

rows: Yes, + olmosh + **do / does**. / No, + olmosh + **don't / doesn't**.

examples.title: **Do** you ...? **Do** they ...?
examples.description: I, you, we, they va ko'plik bilan: **Do** + ega + fe'l? O'zbekchadagi `-mi` o'rnida gap boshidagi **do** turadi.

sentences.text: **Do** you **speak** Russian?
**Do** your children **go** to school near here?
Aziz, **do** you **want** some more tea?
Excuse me, **do** these trains **stop** at Oxford?
**Do** they **sell** SIM cards in this shop?
Mum, **do** we **need** any bread?
So **do** you and Madina **work** together?
Honestly, **do** I **look** OK in this jacket?
Tell me, **do** people in Britain really **drink** so much tea?
sentences.translation: Ayting-chi, Britaniyada odamlar rostdan ham shuncha ko'p choy **ichishadimi**?

sentences.text: Sorry, **do** you **know** the way to the station?

examples.title: **Does** she ...? **Does** it ...? (no **-s**!)
examples.description: he, she, it va bitta kishi / narsa bilan: **Does** + ega + fe'l? **-s** does da, fe'l yalang'och: **Does** he **play**? («Does he plays?» emas).

sentences.text: **Does** your brother **play** chess?
**Does** this bus **go** to Chorsu?
**Does** it **rain** a lot in Manchester?
Madina, **does** your husband **cook**?
Excuse me, **does** the museum **open** on Mondays?
And **does** Sarah **like** her new job?
Tom, **does** your dog **bite**?
So **does** your daughter **live** in London now?
Tell me honestly, **does** this soup **need** more salt?
sentences.translation: Rostini ayting, bu sho'rvaga yana tuz **kerakmi**?

sentences.text: Sorry, **does** the price **include** breakfast?

examples.title: Short answers: **Yes, I do.** / **No, he doesn't.**
examples.description: Qisqa javobda **do / does** qaytariladi, asosiy fe'l takrorlanmaydi: Do you like it? — Yes, I **do** («Yes, I like» emas). / No, he **doesn't**.

sentences.text: Do you like football? — Yes, **I do**.
Does Aziz smoke? — No, **he doesn't**.
Do your parents live in Tashkent? — Yes, **they do**.
Does the hotel have Wi-Fi? — Yes, **it does**.
Excuse me, do you work here? — No, **I don't**, sorry.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, shu yerda ishlaysizmi? — Yo'q, **ishlamayman**, uzr.

sentences.text: Does Emma speak Uzbek? — Yes, **she does**, a little.
Bekzod, do you need help? — No, **I don't**. Thanks!
sentences.translation: Bekzod, yordam kerakmi? — Yo'q, **kerak emas**. Rahmat!

sentences.text: Do Tom and Sarah have children? — Yes, **they do**. They have two boys.
sentences.translation: Tom bilan Saraning farzandlari bormi? — Ha, **bor**. Ikki o'g'li bor.

sentences.text: Mum, does Grandpa know about the party? — No, **he doesn't**. It's a surprise!
sentences.translation: Oyi, bobom bazm haqida biladimi? — Yo'q, **bilmaydi**. Bu kutilmagan sovg'a!

sentences.text: And does this bus stop near the hospital? — Yes, **it does**, right opposite.
sentences.translation: Bu avtobus shifoxona yaqinida to'xtaydimi? — Ha, **to'xtaydi**, roppa-rosa ro'parasida.

examples.title: **Where do** you live? **What does** she do?
examples.description: So'roq so'zi + **do / does** + ega + fe'l: **Where** do you live? **What** does he do? **When** does it leave? **What time** do they close?

sentences.text: **Where do** you **live**?
**What does** your father **do**? — He's an engineer.
**What time do** the shops **close** on Saturday?
**When does** the next train to Bukhara **leave**?
Madina, **where does** your sister **work**?
**What do** you usually **have** for breakfast?
Excuse me, **where do** I **buy** tickets for the museum?
**When do** you **finish** work on Fridays?
Tom, **what does** this word **mean**?
So **where do** your grandparents **spend** the winter — in Tashkent or in the village?
sentences.translation: Xo'sh, bobo-buvingiz qishni **qayerda** o'tkazishadi — Toshkentdami yoki qishloqdami?

examples.title: **How often**, **why**, **how much** + do / does
examples.description: Boshqa so'roq so'zlari: **how** (qanday?), **how often** (qanchalik tez-tez?), **how much** (qancha turadi?), **why** (nega?), **what kind of** (qanaqa?).

sentences.text: **How often do** you **go** to the gym?
**Why do** you **want** to learn English?
**How much does** a taxi to the airport **cost**?
Aziz, **how do** you **get** to work — by bus or by metro?
sentences.translation: Aziz, ishga **qanday** borasan — avtobusdami yoki metrodami?

sentences.text: **Why does** Bekzod always **sit** at the back?
**How often does** your mum **call** you?
**What kind of** music **do** you **like**?
Sarah, **why do** you **look** so tired every morning?
sentences.translation: Sara, **nega** har tongda bunchalik charchagan ko'rinasan?

sentences.text: Excuse me, **how do** you **spell** your surname?
**Why do** cats **sleep** so much? — Nobody really knows.
sentences.translation: Mushuklar **nega** shuncha ko'p uxlaydi? — Buni hech kim aniq bilmaydi.

examples.title: **Are** you ...? or **Do** you ...?
examples.description: **be** bilan gap (sifat, joy, kasb, -ing) — **am / is / are** oldinga; boshqa fe'l — **do / does** oldinga. «Are you like ...?» — xato.

sentences.text: **Are** you a student? **Do** you **study** here?
**Is** your sister married? **Does** she **have** children?
**Do** you **like** your new flat? **Is** it big?
**Are** you hungry? **Do** you **want** a sandwich?
**Is** Tom from London? — No, but he **lives** there now.
sentences.translation: Tom **Londondanmi**? — Yo'q, lekin hozir o'sha yerda **yashaydi**.

sentences.text: **Does** Madina **work** in a hospital? — Yes, she's a nurse.
**Are** the children **sleeping**? — No, they're reading.
Bekzod, **do** you **know** Mr Davies? **Is** he your new teacher?
**Does** this jacket **look** good on me, or **is** it too small?
Tell me, **are** you **working** today, or **do** you **have** a day off?

examples.title: Dialogue: meeting a new neighbour
examples.description: Qo'shni bilan tanishuv: **Do** you ...? **What do** you do? **Where do** you ...? va qisqa javoblar bir suhbatda.

sentences.text: — Hello! **Do** you **live** in this building?
— Yes, **I do**. I'm on the fourth floor. My name's Emma.
sentences.translation: — Ha, **shu yerda yashayman**. To'rtinchi qavatdaman. Ismim Emma.

sentences.text: — Nice to meet you! I'm Aziz. **What do** you **do**, Emma?
sentences.translation: — Tanishganimdan xursandman! Men Azizman. **Nima ish qilasiz**, Emma?

sentences.text: — I'm a nurse. I **work** at the children's hospital. And you?
— I **teach** maths at a school near here. **Do** you **like** this area?
sentences.translation: — Shu yaqindagi maktabda matematikadan **dars beraman**. Bu mahalla sizga **yoqadimi**?

sentences.text: — Yes, it's quiet and green. **Does** your wife **work** near here too?
sentences.translation: — Ha, tinch va yashil. Rafiqangiz ham shu yaqinda **ishlaydimi**?

sentences.text: — No, **she doesn't**. She works in the centre. **Where do** you **buy** bread?
sentences.translation: — Yo'q, **bu yerda emas**. U markazda ishlaydi. Non **qayerdan olasiz**?

sentences.text: — There's a bakery on the corner. It **opens** at six.
sentences.translation: — Muyulishda novvoyxona bor. U soat oltida **ochiladi**.

sentences.text: — Great! **Does** it **sell** samsa too?
— Yes, **it does**, and it's delicious. I **go** there every morning.
sentences.translation: — Ha, **sotadi**, juda mazali. Men u yerga har tongda **boraman**.

examples.title: Mixed: a questionnaire about daily habits
examples.description: Mustahkamlash: kundalik odatlar haqida so'rovnoma — ha / yo'q savollari, so'roq so'zli savollar va javoblar.

sentences.text: **What time do** you usually **get up** on weekdays? — At half past six.
sentences.translation: Ish kunlari odatda **soat nechada turasiz**? — Olti yarimda.

sentences.text: **Do** you **eat** breakfast at home? — No, I don't. I eat at work.
**How do** you **travel** to work or school?
**Does** anyone in your family **smoke**? — No, nobody does.
sentences.translation: Oilangizda kimdir **chekadimi**? — Yo'q, hech kim chekmaydi.

sentences.text: **How many hours do** you **sleep** at night?
**Do** your friends **play** any sports? — Yes, they play volleyball.
sentences.translation: Do'stlaringiz biror sport turi bilan **shug'ullanadimi**? — Ha, voleybol o'ynashadi.

sentences.text: **What do** you **do** in the evenings? — I usually read or watch films.
sentences.translation: Kechqurunlari **nima qilasiz**? — Odatda kitob o'qiyman yoki film ko'raman.

sentences.text: **Why do** you **like** your job? — Because I meet interesting people every day.
sentences.translation: Ishingiz sizga **nega yoqadi**? — Chunki har kuni qiziq odamlar bilan tanishaman.

sentences.text: And **how often does** your family **eat** together?
Last question: **do** you **have** enough free time? — Not really!
sentences.translation: Oxirgi savol: bo'sh vaqtingiz **yetarlimi**? — Unchalik emas!
